111:t_3:65.en:
$$アムロ$$
「After today's battle, $$クロノ$$'s forces will leave the $$連邦軍$$ chain of command and gradually start acting independently.」

111:t_3:67.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Our target is this continent's $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

111:t_3:68.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Some people believe in the future, while others have abandoned it...)

111:t_3:69.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Are people... really moving toward the future...?)

111:t_3:73.en: ～$$オーガスタ$$　$$ニュータイプ$$ Research Institute～

111:t_3:75.en:
$$マーサ$$
「$$プロト・プルトゥエルブ$$... That's your name, isn't it? Answer me.」

111:t_3:77.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You must obey your master's instructions.」

111:t_3:78.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You are not my master. If you want to make me obey, try reconditioning me or torturing me.」

111:t_3:80.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You're too soft, $$アルベルト$$. It seems I made a mistake entrusting her to you.」

111:t_3:81.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You haven't made any progress in these four months... However chaotic the world has been, I can only call that negligence.」

111:t_3:84.en:
$$マーサ$$
「At least these four months have shown me that reconditioning you will be difficult. You are far too perfectly developed.」

111:t_3:87.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I have no interest in people whose memories are easily replaced.」

111:t_3:88.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You will fight for me while carrying the burden of your past.」

111:t_3:90.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I can tell. You've been used as a tool by someone... by men who know only how to spill blood...」

111:t_3:92.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Remember what you were doing before $$ネオ・ジオン$$ took you in...」

111:t_3:94.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Come now... Lay bare your painful past. I'll lead you out of it.」

111:t_3:95.en:
$$マーサ$$
「And... I'll give you the strength to fight...」

111:t_3:98.en:
$$マーサ$$
「It's the result of my investigation into her past. Now we can recondition her.」

111:t_3:99.en:
$$マーサ$$
「She'll give us the strength we need to obtain the $$ユニコーン$$...」

111:t_3:100.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Do we still need to protect $$ラプラスの箱$$ when the $$連邦政府$$ is in this state?」

111:t_3:101.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I no longer expect anything from the $$連邦政府$$. But I'll keep using it as long as it's useful.」

111:t_3:102.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Then what exactly... do you intend to do once you obtain the $$ユニコーン$$?」

111:t_3:105.en:
$$マーサ$$
「So you did know. It's an organization that has protected something called the Doctrine in the shadows of history, gaining immense power in exchange...」

111:t_3:106.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Heh... They're just like the $$ビスト家$$.」

111:t_3:108.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Their supreme leader contacted me. He offered to welcome us into $$クロノ$$ if we hand over $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

111:t_3:110.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Given the situation, neither the $$ビスト家$$ nor $$アナハイム$$ is untouchable.」

111:t_3:111.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Then let's use the existence of that box to ensure our survival.」

111:t_3:113.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You don't need to think about anything else. You will use that $$マリーダ$$ to carry out my orders.」

111:t_3:115.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Heh... The lion and the unicorn... They are both guardian deities of the $$ビスト家$$...」

111:t_3:116.en:
$$マーサ$$
「$$プルトゥエルブ$$... Protect us, won't you?」

111:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It must have been hard to just watch $$アムロ$$ and $$ギュネイ$$ fight.」

111:t_10:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I understand his personality a little. If we'd stepped in, he surely would have despised us.」

111:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's wonderful when friendship endures even on opposing sides.」

111:t_10:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Maybe we're not quite friends...」

111:t_10:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But if he's lost, I want to reach out to him.」

111:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「He's a stubborn man. Once he decides something, he won't change his mind so easily.」

111:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But your words today and his defeat by $$アムロ$$ generated 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$ from $$ギュネイ$$.」

111:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

111:t_10:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So his heart really is wavering...」

111:t_10:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... If we fight him again and he generates $$Ｚチップ$$, let me know.」

111:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. For both our sakes, I hope he generates plenty of $$Ｚチップ$$.」

111:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... assumed you were going to reclaim the $$νガンダム$$ like a child whose toy had been taken away.」

111:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or was it that other thing? I thought you were saying, 'I can use the $$ガンダム$$ better than anyone...'」

111:t_10:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You've got me... I can't say anything when you bring up my past.」

111:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, come on...! Don't act so grown-up. Sometimes, let us see the fiery $$アムロ$$ you used to be.」

111:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Like when you lost your temper at $$ギレン・ザビ$$'s speech and smashed a monitor with your bare hands...」

111:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Where did the $$アムロ$$ who used to get cozy with a blonde go?」

111:t_10:28.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What are you talking about...? Is that from some crackpot book about me during the $$一年戦争$$?」

111:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies! I... got all sorts of things mixed up!」

111:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please forget what I just said! There won't be any direct hits from a $$ビーム・バズーカ$$!」

111:t_10:32.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wait a minute...! What are you talking about?!」

111:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry! It's almost time to open $$Ｄトレーダー$$!」

111:t_10:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Changing the subject that abruptly only makes me more curious!」
